description: This file defines the ProjectTemplateRepository class, which extends the ProjectRepository class and includes a method for constructing a base SQL SELECT query to retrieve project template data along with the count of associated tasks.

classes.name: ProjectTemplateRepository
classes.description: Repository class handling project template data retrieval, extending ProjectRepository.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a SelectQueryBuilder object configured to select project template data along with the number of tasks associated with each project template.
